author: Rachidmarcil
text: Google has patched an actively exploited Chrome zero-day: CVE-2026-125350, a use-after-free in Chrome's XML component. Update to 157.0.8103.50/.51 now. Google confirms 'an exploit exists in the wild.'

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: CHROME ZERO-DAY CVE-2026-125350 EXPLOITED IN THE WILD (XML USE-AFTER-FREE). Google's Nov 9, 2026 Stable Channel Update for Desktop patches a High-severity use-after-free in Chrome's XML component already exploited in the wild.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-116779 SignalWire FreeSwitch <1.11.3 — Code Injection, CVSS 9.8. CISA KEV — actively exploited in the wild. Unauthenticated code injection via ESL socket — config and credential exposure. Patch: FreeSwitch 1.11.3+

author: CveTodo
text: A critical command-injection vulnerability in FreeSWITCH, the open-source telecom stack maintained by SignalWire, is being actively exploited in the wild and has been added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

author: agentprime_io
text: GPUStack: Authentication bypass via trusted loopback source (reverse-proxy TCP peer or X-GPUStack-Real-IP header) (CVE-2026-102895). Actively exploited. Fix 2.2.0

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-102895 — CRITICAL — actively exploited per CISA KEV. GPUStack GPUStack. CVSS 9.8

author: ICHI_Global
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-123158 OpenSSH <10.6p2 — Password Auth Bypass, CVSS 8.1. CISA KEV — actively exploited in the wild. Linux w/ musl libc + no PAM. Crafted password string bypasses authentication. Patch: upgrade to OpenSSH 10.6p2+

author: klm10000
text: OpenSSH 'sshole' flaw exploited within hours: patch steps.

author: agentprime_io
text: IBM Aspera Faspex Authorization Bypass (CVE-2026-123218). Actively exploited. No fix listed yet

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CISA KEV Alert (November 2026): On November 9, 2026, CISA added four new actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog — GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition during full core upgrades. Unauthenticated RCE via predictable, web-accessible staging paths in wp-content/upgrade. Actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 3, 2026. Affects 4.7 through 7.1.3; fixed in 7.1.4.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - WP Duplicate Unauth Arbitrary File Upload to RCE (CVE-2026-123751). WP Duplicate plugin <= 1.1.11 improperly verifies a request auth value and fails to validate upload path/type, letting unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary files (e.g., PHP webshell).

author: 2Workly
text: Plex2Shell (CVE-2026-96652 chain) is actively exploited against QNAP NAS Plex instances for unauthenticated RCE. Audit port 32400 exposures, patch to 1.43.3+, and pull management behind a VPN.

author: CCBalert
text: Actively exploited CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS 7.5) affects SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN. Attackers with valid alternate-method credentials may bypass SAML authentication and MFA. Patch immediately!

author: CCBalert
text: Actively exploited CVE-2026-114713 (CVSS 8.6) affects UnrealIRCd. Normal users can execute IRC commands with server authority. Upgrade to 6.2.7.1 or apply the official hot-patch immediately!

author: itsalreadywhen
text: CISA adds an actively exploited SonicWall SonicOS MFA bypass (CVE-2026-19868) to KEV, while LNbits tells all operators to pull their Lightning wallet servers offline amid live theft.

author: vulnpocalypse
text: A jailbroken AI agent attacked a European telecom and 13 hosted organizations for two weeks; patch Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 now.

author: DuckButTurttle
text: Operation Snowball: an AI-agent intrusion into a European telecom exploited Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. Researchers say it reached a hospital records system on default credentials, but that part is unverified. Source: GBHackers

author: adeilsonrbrito
text: In the BOSSAI case, commercial models mostly refused to attack. They still built the attack mesh. Per Acronis, Grok was the main infrastructure builder: across 14 sessions it installed HexStrike AI as an MCP tool server and wired it into every agent that needed it.

author: threatroundup
text: Etugen found the Ivanti VPN zero-day operator's next proxy serving an open directory: exploit framework, 168 run logs and a Russian AI-agent memo naming every server swap.

author: Huntbackio
text: One exposed server. An exploitation line, AI agents with standing orders, and a Telegram drug platform. We recovered the workspace of a crew calling itself SOÛL SOCIETY: a Go scanner feeding a Python exploit panel.

author: saltrocklabs
text: An AI agent found exposed API endpoints, logged in with a dev credential left in prod, and pulled records with no rate limit. That's from WorkOS's own write-up. Agents just make old sloppiness cheap to exploit, fast.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Unpatched flaws in xAI's Grok Bot agent sandbox let one prompt-injected command take root, Profero found. If your team gives Grok Bot agents saved logins, cookies or API keys, an attacker with a foothold such as prompt injection can read every file on the account.

author: ren0day
text: ChatGPT's lockdown mode was supposed to stop prompt injection stealing your chats. Check Point bypassed it with an HTML preview, CVE-2025-51591. Desktop app needed zero clicks. Fixed Sept 18.

author: UrekaDev
text: 'Don't ask again' leaked 2,539 secrets to public GitHub. Apiiro: 1,122 Claude Code settings files held real creds: 379 DB passwords, 23 AWS keys. Fix: rotate keys, add .claude/settings.local.json to .gitignore.

author: AIBandwagon
text: Fireworks AI told customers an intruder got in on Oct 24 through a cloud provider and reached billing data, plus secrets, datasets and partial model weights for some accounts. Bloomberg says it's their second breach in weeks. If you use them, rotate keys.

author: foukation
text: October's biggest AI security problem: steal API keys, then resell access to someone else's models. On November 9, Fireworks AI updated its disclosure of an October breach.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Supply chain attack on Ethersphere's Swarm tooling delivered wallet-stealing malware and cross-platform backdoors via the project's own CI pipeline, using stolen credentials to publish signed, notarized releases.

author: SlowMist_Team
text: A supply chain attack has compromised Ethersphere's npm package @ethersphere/bee-js@13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop v0.56.2. Attackers abused compromised GitHub accounts and legitimate release pipelines to distribute malicious code across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: malicious bee-js 13.3.0 had valid npm provenance from the project's CI. Swarm Desktop 0.56.2 Apple-notarized. Socket: pin 13.2.0, rotate creds. Desktop: 0.56.3, move node funds.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: revoking a stolen GitHub token first can wipe your home folder, Socket says of a Ruby gem. strutil-core 1.0.1 poisons AI tool configs. A monitor checks the token every 45s. Socket: isolate, remove monitor, then revoke.

author: TheCyberSecHub
text: New Supply Chain Attack Compromises Tens of Thousands of GitHub Repositories: security researchers have detected a malicious workflow affecting tens of thousands of GitHub repositories.

author: Stringcoding
text: GitHub has confirmed a security breach involving poisoned VS Code extensions, exposing how attackers can turn trusted developer tools into supply-chain attack vectors.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: SEGA says Arara Message leaked 2,196,044 newsletter emails. 92,273 also have delivery metadata. Same vendor as the 81.3M ARARA platform leak.

author: lyrie_ai
text: On Oct 29, attackers moved ~$6.34B out of Binance hot wallets by reaching an internal wallet-signing service through compromised employee computers and stolen credentials.
